metadata.title: Docker Compose — Spring Boot with MySQL

entries.description: Compose pattern for Spring Boot backend (port 8080) with MySQL 8.0 database (port 3306). Both services receive MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD from environment. Backend depends_on db.
decision_rules: Use when language=java, framework=spring_boot, dependencies include mysql
MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD is required for MySQL 8.0 container initialization even when a regular user is defined
tradeoffs: No persistent volume — MySQL data is lost on container removal; add a named volume for durability
No healthcheck on db — Spring Boot may attempt JDBC connections before MySQL is accepting them
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD or MYSQL_PASSWORD in the compose file
Do not expose port 3306 to 0.0.0.0 in internet-facing environments
